purpose: Prevent opening/continuous/VI/closing observations from being pooled as if generated by one market mechanism, and prevent auction indicative books from being interpreted as executable continuous-market liquidity.

officialTwseMechanism.volatilityInterruption: when triggered, matching is postponed for two minutes and resumes with call auction before returning to continuous trading
officialTwseMechanism.disclosure: best-five and simulated auction information have mechanism-specific semantics

antiPoolingRules: Primary D05 pressure/spread/depth inference uses CONTINUOUS only until each other mechanism has independent evidence.
Auction/VI/trial best-five snapshots are indicative mechanism states and must not be mixed with continuous executable spread/depth observations.
Opening and closing volatility may contain auction price-discovery/concentration effects; do not label them generic intraday volatility without session controls.
VI-triggered rows are selected by an endogenous volatility event; they cannot be compared naively with ordinary continuous rows.
Missing mechanism classification is UNKNOWN, never CONTINUOUS.

tickInteraction.rule: relativeTickBps is a mandatory control/stratum in spread/depth/volatility inference.
tickInteraction.evidenceBoundary: Historical Taiwan tick-size reductions changed spread and depth, so raw spread/depth are not mechanism-invariant across tick regimes.

firstProspectiveTests: Within symbol/date, estimate continuous-session baselines separately from first 5m, middle session and last continuous 10m; freeze clock slots before outcomes.
Keep OPEN/CLOSE auction and VI observations as separate cohorts; compare only after sufficient independent dates.
For D05 B0-B3, add sessionState and relativeTickBps before interpreting pressure/depth incrementality.
For D04, compare volatility descriptors with and without auction prints; any effect that disappears after session separation is SESSION_MECHANISM_MEDIATED.
Negative control: matched continuous windows with similar local volatility/activity/tick state.
falsification: If apparent open/close alpha disappears after volatility/activity matching, classify as activity concentration rather than session alpha.
If spread/depth effect changes sign across relative-tick strata, prohibit universal liquidity threshold.
If VI cohort drives a result, classify endogenous-event-conditioned and do not generalize.
If auction indicative depth predicts no executable friction after continuous trading begins, keep descriptive only.

systemImplications.potential: Could later prevent false BUY/maxChase/liquidity conclusions caused by session-mechanism contamination.
systemImplications.promotionGate: Prospective PIT capture + independent dates + OOS/walk-forward + cost + redundancy + regime checks.
